summary: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust filed an 8-K reporting the retirement of Trustee Ron E. Jackson at the 2026 annual meeting of shareholders. The meeting also covered election of seven other trustees, ratification of KPMG LLP as auditors, an advisory vote on executive compensation, and an amendment to the declaration of trust. No special-situation event occurred; the filing documents routine board changes and shareholder votes. No deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is present. The filing is a routine current report of corporate governance matters.
